intro: We built Upmods Eudora to hold what your wardrobe can’t. Eudora’s deep underbed storage and wide headboard make it easier to rest well — and organising — beautifully simple.

features.title: Built strong, down to the core
features.text: Crafted from premium engineered wood, our frame provides everyday durability with a clean, modern foundation.

features.title: A headboard that makes a quiet statement
features.text: The wide, rectangular design brings structure to your room while offering a broad backrest for added comfort.

features.title: Lift it once, love it forever
features.text: Hydraulic lift-up storage gives you easy access to space beneath—perfect for seasonal items or daily extras. And with multiple storage options available, you can choose what works best for your home and lifestyle.

features.title: A finish that brings out character
features.text: The walnut brown tone with patterned accents adds rich texture and depth, blending modern style with warmth.

features.title: Coated to stay beautiful longer
features.text: A PU protective layer shields against scratches and wear—keeping your bed looking polished day after day.

name: Upmods Eudora King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
